citation: STARLI / RESEARCH FAMILY III / FLAGSHIPS 281–285 Ten Research Flagships · Letters to Future Laboratories Five research architectures for calibration succession, automated discovery, collaboration, self-repair and quantum sensor recovery. F281 | NANO-QUANTUM RESEARCH SYSTEM CROSS-GENERATION CALIBRATION AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × traceable calibration and reference transfer × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests measurement unit definition survival under a concealed challenge: swap a noncommutable reference standard. Measures: reference-transfer bias [nT]; separate witness: uncertainty coverage [fraction]. Strong comparator: independent reference magnetometry with fixed calibration transfer. Failures remain reportable. F282 | INTELLIGENT MICROROBOTIC AUTOMATED SCIENTIFIC DISCOVERY AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × uncertainty-aware bounded decision. The primary proposal tests sequential experiment acquisition bias under a concealed challenge: change a microgripper contact force. Measures: held-out experiment information gain [bits]; separate witness: hypothesis replication success [fraction]. Strong comparator: randomized factorial design and classical active learning under matched budgets. Failures remain reportable. F283 | NANO-QUANTUM RESEARCH AGENT COLLABORATION AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests conflicting measurement ontology negotiation under a concealed challenge: corrupt one agent clock. Measures: causally valid agreement [fraction]; separate witness: external reconstruction success [fraction]. Strong comparator: single authorized controller with independent scientific adjudicator. Failures remain reportable. F284 | MICROSCALE RESEARCH PLATFORM AUTONOMOUS REPAIR AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests reference-sensor replacement after failure under a concealed challenge: mask a cleaning reagent carryover. Measures: verified restoration yield [fraction]; separate witness: post-repair alignment bias [um]. Strong comparator: manual maintenance under frozen physical qualification limits. Failures remain reportable. F285 | QUANTUM SENSOR RESOURCE CYCLING AND RECOVERY AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests microcoil solder fatigue under a concealed challenge: reuse a shield with unlogged hysteresis. Measures: sensor functional recovery [fraction]; separate witness: recovered component mass [mg]. Strong comparator: new-component replacement with matched metrology and life-cycle accounting. Failures remain reportable. FORMAT Each flagship: 777 English pages · 30 formula plates · 82 chapters / 410 one-page investigations · 200 three-letter Research Gates · 33 Phoenix proposals. All assertions are candidate research designs, not experimental outcomes. STARLI / RESEARCH FAMILY III / FLAGSHIPS 286–290 Evidence, Renewal and Independent Succession Five bounded designs for energy autonomy, remote experimental operation, digital twins, regional quantum networks, and research resilience. F286 | NANOROBOTIC RESEARCH ENERGY AUTONOMY AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests heat accumulation during power recovery under a concealed challenge: insert a low-voltage reset. Measures: usable autonomous runtime [h]; separate witness: mission abort probability [fraction]. Strong comparator: tethered power with full mission and sample-integrity matched accounting. Failures remain reportable. F287 | MICROSCALE AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH STATION REMOTE OPERATION AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests teleoperation feedback bandwidth under a concealed challenge: insert a duplicate remote command. Measures: remote command causal latency [s]; separate witness: blind mission completion [fraction]. Strong comparator: local supervised microfluidic operation at matched physical and operator budgets. Failures remain reportable. F288 | NANO-QUANTUM LABORATORY TRUSTWORTHY DIGITAL TWIN AT THE LIMIT Three-coupling: long-horizon scientific memory × modular autonomous infrastructure × intergenerational evidence transfer. The primary proposal tests microfluidic geometry representation error under a concealed challenge: substitute an untrained device geometry. Measures: normalized held-out physical residual [dimensionless]; separate witness: calibration parameter identifiability [fraction]. Strong. 33. 2026-11-04. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23935352
